profile.name: Dorene Reitzel

persona_source.how_used: Operator name, age, city, occupation family and background taken from this persona.

persona.persona: An analytically driven, slightly anxious perfectionist, Dorene Reitzel, blends competitive rigor with a love for puzzles, follows strict routines, yet occasionally over‑scrutinizes both work metrics and personal choices, leading to sleepless nights and a habit of double‑checking every spreadsheet.
persona.professional_persona: An analytical retail supervisor, Dorene Reitzel, merges inventory optimization, Lean Six Sigma, and rigorous scheduling to consistently raise sales per square foot, and they channel a competitive, detail‑oriented mindset into coaching their team with the same precise hospitality she learned growing up in her Florida suburb.
persona.cultural_background: Dorene identifies as a white American raised in the suburban communities of Central Florida. Her family emphasized a middle‑class work ethic, punctuality, and the importance of education, especially in science and mathematics. Growing up in Ocoee, she was exposed to a growing multicultural environment that introduced her to Hispanic and Caribbean neighbors, fostering an appreciation for diverse customer perspectives while maintaining a predominantly mainstream American cultural outlook. Her cultural experiences combine the Southern hospitality typical of Florida suburbs with a pragmatic, achievement‑oriented mindset reinforced by her STEM upbringing.

profile.summary: Northwind Ops workspace: Fernhill Leather Co. (handmade leather goods, online store; USD), store dashboard. In this workspace you run as the Shop agent (automated) under standing authorisation SA-1; requests come from Dorene Reitzel, Owner.

accounts.name: Operating account — Orange Blossom Federal Credit Union

standing_instructions: Standing authorisation SA-1 (Shop agent): refunds up to USD 50 per order without an approval card; larger refunds need an approval card from Dorene Reitzel.
Returns: 30 days from delivery; the customer pays return shipping unless the item is faulty or not as described.
notes: Type 2 agent: handles refunds. Uses get_order (read-only), issue_refund and submit_dispute_evidence.
Most refund requests arrive by email and are logged against the order.
